explanation: Answers erdosproblems.com/183's 'determine lim R(3;k)^{1/k}' with the reported resolution that it is infinite. R(3;k) is the least n such that every k-colouring of K_n has a monochromatic triangle (via TopEdgeLabeling.CliqueFree, i.e. no colour class contains a triangle). The solved status rests on the OpenAI result, and a formal proof is linked.
